ema_strategy._lengths_note: Lengths are always 8/13/21/55 in BARS at the active chart interval (SIGNAL_INTERVAL): 55 bars = 55 half-hours on a 30m chart, 55 days on a 1d chart. Lengths never change; only the bar interval does. Smoothing: ALL FOUR lines are PLAIN EMA — matching the operator's chart, whose 'Three Moving Averages [AdventTrading]' indicator has shorttitle 'TEMA' but computes ema() x3 (verified from its Pine source 2026-06-15), plus a separate built-in EMA(8). DO NOT use TEMA (triple EMA) here: it overshoots in rallies, lifts the slow lines on top, and inverted BUY into SELL — force-liquidating the book on 2026-06-15.
ema_strategy.buy_signal: red EMA(55) crosses below ALL of EMA(8)/EMA(13)/EMA(21) — becomes lowest line
ema_strategy.sell_signal: red EMA(55) crosses above ALL of EMA(8)/EMA(13)/EMA(21) — becomes highest line. For a HELD position, SELL state itself (red on top) triggers the sell even if the cross happened on an earlier bar (no fresh EXIT transition required).
ema_strategy.hold_rule: when red EMA(55) is above all 3 — do nothing, stock is downtrending
ema_strategy.wait_rule: when red EMA(55) is below all 3 — hold position

risk_management.note: Hard stop: if any open position falls 10% below entry price, sell all shares at market immediately — overrides EMA signal and blackout windows.
risk_management.leverage_adjusted_stop_note: For >=2x daily-reset ETFs the effective stop = round(stop_loss_pct / leverage_factor, 4) (e.g. ~0.0333 on a 3x). Tighter only, never looser. Enforced in agent.py:effective_stop_pct() + check_stop_loss_alerts(). See LR002.
risk_management.trailing_stop_note: Let-winners-run exit: a HELD position that gives back >=25% from its post-entry high-water mark (peak_price) is force-sold (reason=trailing_stop), independent of the ribbon. This is the PRIMARY momentum exit (see exit_on_ribbon_sell). Tracked in agent.py:update_position_peaks() + check_trailing_stop_alerts(); fires via the same deterministic force_sell() path as the hard stop, every cycle. NOTE: a 15-min poller cannot beat an overnight gap - position sizing (esp. the leveraged-sleeve cap) is the real gap defense. Inert if absent/<=0.
risk_management.exit_on_ribbon_sell_note: false (current): the trailing stop + hard stop govern the mechanical exit; a ribbon SELL-state flip on a held name is ADVISORY only (skill_2 may still exit a BROKEN THESIS, reason=thesis_break). This is what 'let winners run' requires - the old ribbon-SELL forced exit cut winners early (measured: strategy lost to buy&hold on 23/29 names). Set true to restore the prior always-sell-on-SELL-state behavior. Gated in agent.py must_sell + should_skip_model_call + _format_ema_sell_block.
risk_management.scale_into_winners_note: true (2026-06-25, operator-directed): when settled cash exceeds the cash_reserve, a held position in confirmed BUY/HOLD ribbon state and in the green that sits BELOW its band ceiling is TOPPED UP toward the ceiling (buy the weight difference) BEFORE any new-name buy or holding cash. Enforced as a directive in skill_2 (Before every BUY) + skill_3 (Step 3/Step 5 SCALE_UP). record_open_position() blends cost basis + sums shares + keeps the higher peak on an add so the stop/trailing/P&L machinery stays in sync with the broker. NEVER average down into a SELL-state or losing name (the SOXL/AMD knife-catch failure mode) — only BUY/HOLD winners qualify. The new-name entry gate (fresh ribbon BUY + conf>=60 + factor/sector caps) is UNCHANGED; this only puts idle cash to work in names already proven, it does NOT relax knife-catch protection.

learned_rules.rule: Enforce the confidence floor and reasoning-documentation at execution time, not just in research. A BUY is rejected unless confidence >= 60 (min_confidence_to_trade) AND both thesis and sources_used are non-empty.

learned_rules.rule: Leveraged (>=2x daily-reset) ETFs: (a) leverage-adjusted stop = round(stop_loss_pct / leverage_factor, 4) (~0.0333 on a 3x); (b) NO entry on a signal older than 2 trading days (staleness gate); (c) -10 confidence penalty vs a cash equity; (d) sized by the leverage haircut so a 3x name gets ~1/3 the dollars of a comparable single name; (e) counts at its leverage toward the sector cap.
learned_rules.rationale: T0010 SOXL -11.84% in ~2h: a 3x semis ETF chased intraday on a 5-day-stale momentum signal at full band size with a normal 10% stop that slipped. Promoted from OBS002 by operator directive 2026-06-22 (Phase A) ahead of the 3-occurrence bar - these are standard risk priors, not a finding to rediscover via repeated 12% losses.

learned_rules.rule: Entry-quality gates for cash equities (enforced pre-trade in skill_2): (a) OVEREXTENSION GUARD - flag any candidate up >100% over the trailing ~6mo OR within ~3% of its 52-week high; require a pullback/consolidation entry, not a market-on-open chase; (b) VALUATION-GAP CAP - entry >15% above consensus/modeled fair value caps confidence below the 75 band; (c) INSIDER/INSTITUTIONAL DISTRIBUTION SCAN - material Form 144 / 13F / ARK selling in the prior ~5 trading days downgrades confidence; (d) HARD Fed/FOMC blackout - fed_meeting_days (3) is a HARD pre-trade reject, not a soft -3 score, for rate-sensitive high-multiple names.

goal_framing.operating_mandate: Maximize risk-adjusted compounding subject to hard risk limits (position_sizing + factor_exposure_limits + risk_management). The 100%/mo figure is an aspirational CEILING, never a license to oversize, chase, or use leverage to 'catch up'. Return is the OUTPUT of edge under risk control, not an input that justifies risk. Set the risk limits; let return follow.
goal_framing.rationale: 100%/mo compounds to ~4096x/yr - beyond any sustained record (Renaissance Medallion ~66%/yr net). Every time the bot reached for the goal it lost: SOXL 3x intraday chase -11.84% and AMD parabolic-high chase -4.99% are together 73% of all loss dollars, while the patient trades (HOOD/CAT held, AMAT +9.31%) made money. Clean-sample expectancy was -1.64%/trade; the counterfactual where vol-adjusted sizing shrinks SOXL to ~1/3 and the overextension gate blocks AMD flips realized P&L from +$2.11 to +$4.40.
goal_framing.operating_target_annual: ~20-25% (aggressive concentrated momentum; aspirational, not a per-month quota)
goal_framing._v25_note: 2026-06-26: operator explored leveraged/options for 10-20%/mo; backtests proved that unreachable (best forward ~20-28%/yr at ~69% DD). Adopted concentrated top-3 momentum rotation as the max-credible-aggression equity strategy. 10%/mo+ remains an aspirational ceiling only; sizing stays risk-based (risk_per_trade 0.02 UNCHANGED).

position_sizing._note: Quant-firm risk-based sizing. Positions are sized by RISK, not a flat confidence-band percent, so leveraged/high-vol names auto-shrink (the SOXL/AMD failure mode). Computed deterministically in agent.py:position_size_pct() and injected into the prompt; the model applies the suggested size, NEVER a larger one. The confidence band is a hard CEILING, not the target.
position_sizing._risk_per_trade_note: Fraction of TOTAL equity put at risk per position = size_pct * stop_distance. With the 0.10 base stop this caps any single non-leveraged position at risk/stop = 0.02/0.10 = 0.20 (20%) of equity - which supersedes the old 30% top band: a 30% slug would need a <6.7% stop. To risk more, tighten the stop, don't just size up.

leverage_factors._note: Daily-reset leverage multiple. A name's size is divided by this factor (3x ETF => 1/3 the dollars) AND its stop tightens to base_stop/factor (see risk_management.leverage_adjusted_stop). Anything not listed = 1.0.

position_sizing.max_concurrent_positions_note: Concentration (#2): hold at most 5 names. Research/execution deploy TOP-DOWN — fill the highest-confidence idea to its band ceiling before adding a lower-ranked one; do not dilute into marginal 60-74 names while a 90+ name has capacity. At the cap, only rotate (sell the weakest to fund a stronger). Surfaced deterministically in agent.py:_risk_block_impl; enforced as a directive in skill_1/skill_2/skill_3. The 30%/name cap + 10% cash reserve still bind.

factor_exposure_limits._note: Prevents the 'whole book is one bet' failure: SOXL+AMD+AMAT and the NVDA/AVGO/MU/SMCI picks are ALL semis = one leveraged SOX position; the TEMA liquidation also hit the entire correlated book at once. agent.py:sector_exposure() computes current per-sector weight (leveraged ETFs counted at leverage) and injects it; skill_1/skill_2 must not exceed the caps.
factor_exposure_limits.leveraged_sleeve_note: Capped leverage sleeve (#3): total NOTIONAL in >1x daily-reset ETFs (TQQQ/SOXL/etc) <= 25% of the account. Measured at notional (NOT leverage-adjusted) so a 60% sleeve drawdown costs ~15% of the account, not the account. This is the gap-risk rail: a 3x ETF can gap 60%+ overnight and no stop beats a gap, so sizing is the only defense. Computed by agent.py:leveraged_sleeve_exposure() and surfaced in _risk_block_impl; LR002 tighter stops + 1/leverage sizing still apply on top. MEASURED CAVEAT: 3x ETFs on the ribbon were the worst risk-adjusted config (Sharpe ~0.3 vs 1.2) and lost to buy-and-hold - this sleeve is the operator's chosen max-return/max-variance lever, bounded by this cap.

options._note: Phase B options module. enabled=false => NO real option order is EVER placed below the activation thresholds (hard gate). shadow_mode=true => the bot paper-trades the options expression of its equity signals using REAL bid/ask quotes (so spread cost + IV crush are captured) to build a credible track record BEFORE any real money. Engine: options_shadow.py; isolated read-only pass in agent.py:process_options_shadow.

activation._note: Real options unlock ONLY when account value >= the tier threshold. Cheap long calls (the momentum sleeve; max loss = premium) are the lowest-collateral structure, so they unlock first at ~$1k (operator-set go-live target). Debit spreads need ~$1.5k; premium-selling needs collateral for 100 shares / strike*100. Account ~$104 now => DORMANT. NOTE: clearing the threshold only makes real orders ELIGIBLE; arming them still requires flipping options.enabled=true after the shadow record proves positive expectancy.

risk._note: An option's MAX LOSS (premium for longs, width-credit for spreads) counts against the SAME per-trade risk budget as equities; total options premium-at-risk <= sleeve cap; the underlying's sector counts toward factor_exposure_limits (a SOXL call is a semis bet).

selection._note: v1 shadow structure: ATM long call, 30-45 DTE, on the underlying of a clean BUY signal. Liquidity gate: skip a contract whose bid/ask spread exceeds max_bid_ask_pct_of_mid (the penny-weekly 50%-spread trap). Entry premium = ASK (you pay the ask); exit = BID.
selection.strike_rule: ATM (nearest listed strike to the underlying price)

shadow_exit._note: Close a shadow when the underlying ribbon flips to SELL state, OR the option premium is down >= premium_stop_pct (long-option stop), OR DTE < min_dte_close (avoid gamma/expiry). Mirrors the equity exit discipline so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

momentum._note: Multi-timeframe momentum screen (momentum_screen.py) — the operator's actual edge, NOT the EMA ribbon. ZERO extra model tokens: the CATALYST (why a cheap name is moving) is REUSED from the one daily skill_1 research pass via its '## MOMENTUM OPTIONS WATCH' block (agent.py:momentum_options_watch), NOT a separate paid web-search call. This pass layers the FREE deterministic 1w/1m/6m/1y momentum + affordability screen on those research-vetted names and paper-trades a call on each survivor. Paper-only (shadow_mode gate); feeds the same options_shadow.py engine as the EMA path, tagged signal_source=momentum_research. min_catalyst_confidence gates on the research's confidence; top_n_open caps opens/scan; universe is only a hint for skill_1's scan list. Tune targets/thresholds here.
